name: Published on Main

menus.name: Harvest tasting menu
menus.note: Autumn menu, 7 October 2026 to 5 January 2027, served nightly; snacks then a run of composed plates; prepaid, with tax and service added. Price from the OpenTable booking page; the $155 pairing is the summer menu's (Scout Magazine, July 2026), not yet confirmed for this one.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, from the restaurant's reservations page (separate links for à la carte and the Harvest tasting menu). Phone bookings 2pm to 5pm, or in person 5pm to 10pm.
cancellation: Tasting menus are paid when booking. Changes or cancellations up to 48 hours before are refunded automatically; later changes, cancellations and no-shows lose the payment. Tables are held for 15 minutes, and late arrivals for the tasting menu may miss courses or move to à la carte.
groups: Parties of more than six must book ahead. A family-style chef's dinner in the lounge (snacks, three courses and desserts) is for groups of 7 to 12. Group enquiries to info@publishedyvr.com; full buyouts for 60 or more (lunch buyouts from 30) through bookings@publishedyvr.com.
duration: Two and a half to three hours for the Harvest tasting menu; tables are reserved for 2¾ hours for two and 3 hours for three or four.
